[b]DISCLAIMER FOR WRITING STYLE
[/b]The dialogue in this mod is written informally and according to common speech patterns, so it is NOT always grammatically correct. Words may be dropped, conjunctions skipped, and improper words used. Formal grammar is not natural speech and sounds forced and flat when used for dialogue.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768198861.png[/img]
This mod is an extremely story-heavy, immersive play-through for Sam and includes his friends along the way.

Sam matures and changes through the first year, struggling through career insecurities and finding his passions along the way. This mod is true to Sam's vanilla personality, he is goofy, fun, and VERY clingy. Just ask Seb, there's a reason for the bowl of saltwater taffy on his desk. From day one, Sam falls for farmer, quite literally, and learns how to have a healthy, mature relationship. There is no "slow burn" here, Sam falls hard and fast, just as he does in vanilla. This leads to many shenanigans and a lot of fun, [b]don't try to take things too seriously[/b]. Sam is here for a relaxing good time.

This mod assumes you are planning to date/marry Sam. It's laid out with a story structure with a lot of character-building events.

[b]PLEASE READ SO YOU DON'T MISS EVENTS!!![/b]
A new save is required to see all events!
Sam will confess and propose to farmer, if you jump ahead and do this yourself, you WILL miss events. I can't fix this, you have to pay attention.

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Dialogue Style[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Narration Style[/b]
Select the narration style: either farmer's thoughts or a narrator.
Farmer's thoughts is first person dialogue
Narrator is third person like a storyteller

[b]Farmer neutral pronouns[/b]
Select 'Yes' to use gender neutral pronouns for farmer (they, their).
No other pronoun options are available.

[b]Sebastian friendship dialogue[/b]
Uncheck to remove Sebastian's friendship dialogue (not recommended).

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Customization[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Vincent's familiar name[/b]
Enter what name Vincent should call you, examples: Big Sis, Big Bro, Auntie, Uncle, or simply your farmer's name.
Default is Big Sis, so change this if your farmer is male or gender neutral.

[b]Sam's name for farmer[/b]
Enter the endearment Sam should call you after dating, fun examples: Maplesugar, Songbird, HoneyBunny, Sugarbear, or simply your farmer's name.
Default is Maplesugar, he does LOVE maple bars.

[b]Farmer's hair length[/b]
Does your farmer have long or short hair? (Regardless of gender) Determines a silhouette sprite used in an event.

[b]SC character name[/b]
Enter a name for the Solarion Chronicles character you create with Sam and Sebastian, this character will be used in an event.
Default is Arden

[b]SC character pronouns[/b]
Choose the pronouns for your Solarion Chronicles character.

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Custom Sprites[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Sam's custom event sprites[/b]
Enables custom sprites for certain events. Selecting 'No' will show alternate visuals in some events and remove some non-essential events that require custom sprites. If you are using Seasonal Outfits, download the compatible patch for the custom sprites.
See the compatible sprite packs in the description below, you can also use my Seasonal Sam Portraits and Sprites mod, just turn off the portraits in that mod if you only want the overworld sprites.

[b]Baby sprite edit[/b]
Enables a minor edit to the baby sprite, recoloring the blanket to a mint green and making the infant slightly smaller.

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Event Options[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Story Event Pace[/b]
Slow Time Based: the story unfolds over the first year and a half, wait for Sam to confess to see all content.
Fast Heart Based: removes the event time spacing, farmer can confess at any time but events might be skipped.

[b]Event End Day option[/b]
Some events end the day. Choose 'No' to keep any event from ending the day.

[b]Moonlight Jellies edit[/b]
Allows Sam to stand with farmer at the Moonlight Jellies festival pre-marriage.

[b](Marriage) Morning Greetings (non-PolyAmory play)[/b]
Enables a Good Morning mini event with randomized dialogue.
Select the event frequency: Saturdays, 3 days a week, daily, or none.

[b]Custom Morning event map[/b]
Enables a custom map for the Good Morning event location, set to 'no' if you want to use the farmhouse kitchen and you don't have a farmhouse mod.

[b]Farmer's birthday month[/b]
Select the season for your farmer's birthday, this is used for custom events. Avoid festival days, and if you are using the Happy Birthday mod, select the same day.
This is currently used for the special birthday good morning event.

[b]Farmer's birthday date[/b]
Select the day for your farmer's birthday, this is used for custom events. Avoid festival days, and if you are using the Happy Birthday mod, select the same day.

[b]Wedding Replay[/b]
Allows the wedding to be replayed by entering debug ebi MaggSamWedding in the SMAPI console.

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Custom Decor[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Spouse Room[/b]
Enables minor edits to the vanilla spouse room after having a baby.
Very minor edits from vanilla, I plan to add a more customized spouse room in the future.

[b]Outside Decor[/b]
Enables outside decor related to Sam's events.
Check "No" if the Town Garden conflicts with other overworld sprite mods you're using, however, this will make the related events basically nonsense.[/spoiler]
